explanation:
(a)    100 mL   NaOH will nutalise

100 mL   HCl, so number extra

HCl   will remain.

This will be neutral solution

pH = 7

(b)    Here 25 mL  NaOH   nutralise

25 mL   HCl

Extra HCl   =   75 25   =   50 mL

Total volume   =   75 + 25   =   100 mL

Milimole of HCl   =   = 10

Concentration of HCl  =   = 0.1

pH  =  log[H+]  =  log(0.1)  =  1

(c)    HCl left  =  60 40  =  20 mL

milimole of HCl   =     =  2

Concentration of HCl   =     =  0.02 M

pH  =  log (0.02)   =   1.69

(d)    HCl left  = 55 45  =  10 mL

milimole of HCl   =    = 1

Concentration of HCl  =    =  0.01 M

pH = log (0.01) = 2
